source.name: Capital Sport (capitalfm.co.ke): Nairobi City Thunder Name Send App as Main Sponsor Ahead of Saturday Season Opener
source.quote: Nairobi City Thunder have announced Send App, a cross-border remittance and payments platform by Flutterwave, as the club’s front-of-shirt sponsor on a two-season deal
source.note: Two-season deal starting with the 2026 campaign; Send App's Head of Business tied it to the club's 2026 BAL campaign (both on the cited page).

source.name: Pulse Sports Kenya: Nairobi City Thunder Secure KSh 10 Million Sponsorship Boost Ahead of 2026 Season
source.quote: the banking partner will receive back-of-jersey branding on all official game kits
source.note: I&M Bank, Official Banking Partner; the agreement officially runs 25 May 2026 to September 2026, with an automatic extension should the campaign continue (all stated on the cited page).

source.name: NBA Communications (pr.nba.com): BAL and Rwanda Development Board multi-year extension
source.quote: Visit Rwanda will continue to be showcased on BAL team uniforms and at the BAL Combine.
source.note: League-wide uniform branding. Nairobi City Thunder play in BAL Season 6 (the league's team page, bal.nba.com/teams/nairobi-city-thunder-kenya), so the league-wide branding covers this club. The BAL's own highlights photo of an NCT Season 6 game (https://cdn-bal.nba.com/manage/sites/3/2026/03/maxresdefault-22.jpg, linked from the league's NCT team page) shows 'VISIT RWANDA' on the chest of NCT's white jersey, beneath the NCT mark.

source.name: Arab News: Qatar Foundation and Basketball Africa League to drive social impact through sport
source.quote: with QF’s Sidra tree logo featuring on all BAL team uniforms
source.note: League-wide BAL Season 6 branding: QF is the BAL's first Official Community Partner (the live Arab News page blocks scripted access, so the Wayback capture of 15 May 2026 is cited). The article names no placement on the uniform. Sponsor record left unrated: the Qatar Foundation's tie to the Qatari state needs a maintainer decision, shared with the other BAL clubs.

source.name: Zawya (APO Group, on behalf of the BAL): Basketball Africa League Names PUMA as League's Official Outfitter Ahead of 2026 Season
source.quote: will see PUMA supply all official BAL team, fan and referee apparel, including game uniforms, warm-up gear, practice wear, accessories
source.note: Kit maker, recorded as partner per existing convention: the collaboration begins with the 2026 BAL season, and the PUMA logo sits on the chest of NCT's Season 6 jerseys in the BAL's own photos (team-presentation graphic and game photos on the league's NCT team page, bal.nba.com/teams/nairobi-city-thunder-kenya).

summary: 2026 home kit, two contexts. Club sponsors: Send App (Flutterwave's remittance platform) is front-of-shirt sponsor on a two-season deal starting with the 2026 campaign (club announcement, Capital Sport, 9 Feb 2026), and I&M Bank is Official Banking Partner with back-of-jersey branding on all official game kits, 25 May to September 2026 (Pulse Sports Kenya, 17 Jun 2026). The BAL Season 6 game uniform is league-supplied by PUMA, the BAL's Official Outfitter from 2026 (Zawya/APO, 17 Mar 2026), and carries 'VISIT RWANDA' on the front chest (pr.nba.com, 19 Jun 2023; visible on the league's own NCT Season 6 game photo) and Qatar Foundation's Sidra tree logo on all BAL team uniforms (Arab News, 14 May 2026). sponsorsComplete is false: no photo of the domestic KNBL game jersey was found, so not every placement could be checked; the club announcements cover only the front and the back.
